title: Marcello. Finalmente!
subtitle: Rodolfo tells Marcello he wants to leave Mimì, then admits she is gravely ill, while she listens in hiding, La bohème, Act 3

passages.label: Rodolfo comes out of the tavern: Io voglio separarmi da Mimì (Moderato con moto)
Già un'altra volta: his heart revived, and now wearied; Marcello: Cambia metro (Allegro moderato, (16))
Se non ride e sfavilla: Marcello calls him jealous; Mimì listens, hidden
Mimì è una civetta: Rodolfo's ironic portrait ((19))
Lo devo dir? Ebbene no: Invan nascondo (Sostenendo, (20))
Amo Mimì sovra ogni cosa al mondo, ma ho paura

licences.source: Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa, libretto of La bohème (1896)
licences.author: Luigi Illica (1857–1919) and Giuseppe Giacosa (1847–1906)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Ricordi vocal score.

licences.source: G. Ricordi & C. vocal score of La bohème, pages 192-198 (from Rodolfo's entrance at the top of page 192, Moderato con moto, to page 198 without its last bar, which holds Rodolfo's upbeat to "Mimì è tanto malata!", 112 bars)
licences.author: Carlo Carignani (1857–1919), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. Rodolfo's bars printed in 2/4 against the piano's 6/8 (bars 28-38) are written into the 6/8 bars. Tempo from the printed Allegro moderato ♩. = 126 at figure (16) (bar 13), kept bar for bar (♩ = ♩.) across the change to 2/4 at bar 39; the Moderato con moto, a piacere, Meno, Sostenendo and the tempo after the rall. of bars 80-81 are values chosen as stated in the piece's notes.
